title: AI in pure C# (A glimpse into how the frameworks work)

cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this AI into Sharp video on not the agent framework because today we
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎觀看這支 C# AI 教學影片。今天的主題不是 Agent Framework，因為我們

cues.en: are going to do AI in pure C Sharp, meaning no frameworks, no extensions AI, no open AI, no agent framework.
cues.zh: 要用純 C# 實作 AI，不使用任何框架、不使用 Extensions.AI、OpenAI 套件，也不使用 Agent Framework。

cues.en: So here you're actually seeing my CS Pro, there's absolutely no NuGet packages.
cues.zh: 現在看到的就是專案檔，裡面完全沒有 NuGet 套件。

cues.en: And the big thing you should ask yourself right now is why?
cues.zh: 此時你最應該問自己的問題是：為什麼？

cues.en: Well, this is not something I would recommend you ever doing.
cues.zh: 首先，我完全不建議你在實際開發中這樣做。

cues.en: The reason why I'm doing it is for purely educational reasons, because this is actually
cues.zh: 這次之所以這樣做，純粹是為了教學，因為這其實是

cues.en: a good way to understand better what is actually happening inside the Microsoft agent framework.
cues.zh: 更深入理解 Microsoft Agent Framework 內部運作的好方法。

cues.en: Because if we went to the agent framework and begin to step through, there would be so many small things, because it can do so many different things, that it would be kind
cues.zh: 如果直接進入 Agent Framework 一步步追蹤，因為它支援很多功能，會遇到大量細節，反而很難，

cues.en: of hard to understand.
cues.zh: 看清楚核心原理。

cues.en: So what I'm doing here is I'm making a mini version of the agent framework so we can better
cues.zh: 因此這裡要製作一個迷你版的 Agent Framework，幫助我們，

cues.en: understand what the core essentials are when we're actually calling a LLM.
cues.zh: 理解呼叫 LLM 時，真正必要的核心部分。

cues.en: So let's jump into that.
cues.zh: 接著開始吧。

cues.en: So in my sample repo, which you can get up on GitHub, on the other topics, I have this do-it-yourself AI calling.
cues.zh: 在 GitHub 上的範例儲存庫中，Other Topics 底下有這個 Do It Yourself AI Calling。

cues.en: And this, as I mentioned, don't have any NuGet package, and I haven't even taken my shared
cues.zh: 如前面所說，它沒有任何 NuGet 套件，甚至沒有引用我平常使用的共用，

cues.en: folder and stuff, it is 100% self-contained, just so you can see that it is possible.
cues.zh: 資料夾。所有內容百分之百獨立，只為了讓你看到，這樣確實做得到。

cues.en: And if we look at the program CS, we'll go to all code in this, it looks kind of like agent framework.
cues.zh: 接著看 Program.cs，稍後會介紹全部程式碼。整體看起來有點像 Agent Framework。

cues.en: There's something called a provider instead of an Azure OpenAI client, something called
cues.zh: 這裡不用 AzureOpenAIClient，而是稱為 Provider，另外還有，

cues.en: MyAgent, and I've called them My in order to indicate that it's not an existing object from anything.
cues.zh: MyAgent。我加上 My 前綴，是為了表示這些不是現成的框架物件。

cues.en: So we have a MyAgent that we do a run async on, where the first question is, what's the capital of France?
cues.zh: 這裡對 MyAgent 呼叫 RunAsync，第一個問題是：法國的首都是哪裡？

cues.en: And we get a MyResponse back, and send that back.
cues.zh: 取得 MyResponse，再把結果顯示出來。

cues.en: Then we do some structured output with the regular movie we want to have, and get it
cues.zh: 接著使用結構化輸出，指定一般的 Movie 型別，並取得，

cues.en: back with a response of movie, and where we can get the result, the name and year of release and so on.
cues.zh: Movie 的泛型回應，裡面可以讀取結果、電影名稱、上映年份等等。

cues.en: And finally, we add a tool to the agent, and we ask a question, let's use that tool, meaning getWeather.
cues.zh: 最後加入一個工具，再提出會使用這個工具的問題，也就是 GetWeather。

cues.en: So this looks kind of familiar, but again, it's written entirely in C-sharp only.
cues.zh: 所以看起來很熟悉，但再次強調，全部都只用 C# 撰寫。

cues.en: And if we run it, and it's just a big system, so we can just see it will ask the first question,
cues.zh: 執行看看。因為是完整的流程，可以看到先提出第一個問題，

cues.en: answer back, ask the second question, answer back, and show it in structured output.
cues.zh: 取得答案，再提出第二個問題，取得結構化輸出並顯示。

cues.en: And the third one is calling a tool.
cues.zh: 第三個則會呼叫工具。

cues.en: So this would be the normal thing we would do in agent framework, but let's see what it actually takes in order to build this.
cues.zh: 這些都是平常在 Agent Framework 會做的事，但接著看看，實際上需要哪些程式碼才能建立這套功能。

cues.en: So the first thing I do is just a little help of methods in order to get my endpoint and
cues.zh: 首先用一些輔助方法，取得端點與，

cues.en: API key, because I didn't want to use any NuGet packages, so I couldn't use a user sequence.
cues.zh: API 金鑰。因為不想使用任何 NuGet 套件，所以不能使用 User Secrets。

cues.en: So I've used environment variables, so I just have two environment variables in my system, one of them being secret.
cues.zh: 因此改用環境變數。系統裡只有兩個環境變數，其中一個是秘密值。

cues.en: And we can see here that I'm just asking if the environment variable is there, and if
cues.zh: 這裡會先檢查環境變數是否存在，如果，

cues.en: it is, we return it, else we ask for it using the console, and so on.
cues.zh: 存在就回傳；否則透過主控台詢問等等。

cues.en: So let me just quickly get rid of my existing values, and let me run it for you.
cues.zh: 先快速移除現有的值，再執行給你看。

cues.en: So now I've removed the values with the magic of editing, and when I run the code now, it will ask for my endpoint.
cues.zh: 透過剪輯，我已經移除原本的值。現在執行時，就會詢問端點。

cues.en: And of course, we get our endpoints up in Microsoft Boundaries, so we see the Azure OpenAI endpoint, and we paste it in.
cues.zh: 端點當然可以從 Microsoft Foundry 取得，找到 Azure OpenAI 端點並貼上。

cues.en: And then it asks for my key, and I don't want you to show my key, but of course I have to take it here, and here it's just that I can paste it, but you can't see it being pasted.
cues.zh: 接著詢問金鑰。我不想讓你看到，所以這裡可以貼上，但畫面不會顯示貼入的內容。

cues.en: So now my two values are in, and if I run it again, it will now ask for it, they are just in the two variables.
cues.zh: 現在兩個值都設定好了。再次執行時就不會詢問，因為已經存在環境變數中。

cues.en: So the first thing we need to do, similar to what we do in Agent Framework, is to use a provider.
cues.zh: 首先，和 Agent Framework 類似，需要使用一個 Provider。

cues.en: And in my case, a provider is a very simple thing, in that it's just an endpoint, an API key, and a model, and it has a way of making an agent.
cues.zh: 這裡的 Provider 非常簡單，只有端點、API 金鑰、模型，以及建立代理程式的方法。

cues.en: So this will normally be an extension method, because Agent Framework would not be able
cues.zh: 正常情況下，這會是擴充方法，因為 Agent Framework 無法直接，

cues.en: to hook directly into the provider, so they would use the static disk method, and so on.
cues.zh: 修改供應商的用戶端，所以會用靜態擴充方法等方式。

cues.en: But because I own the provider here, I could do it without any problems.
cues.zh: 不過這裡的 Provider 由我自己控制，因此可以直接加入方法。

cues.en: We will go into what myAgent is, but you can see we're just nearing one up, and we're giving the provider, so when the agent needs to make a call, it can know the endpoint, API key,
cues.zh: 稍後會介紹 MyAgent。現在只是建立實例，並傳入 Provider，讓代理程式呼叫時能知道端點、API 金鑰，

cues.en: and model inside. What else?
cues.zh: 與模型。另外還需要什麼？

cues.en: We're asking for instructions and tools, just like normal.
cues.zh: 和往常一樣，接收指示與工具。

cues.en: Next up, we get our agent, as we just saw.
cues.zh: 接著就取得剛剛看到的代理程式。

cues.en: So from here until here, there's nothing special, so let's just run the code.
cues.zh: 從這裡到這裡沒有特別之處，直接繼續執行。

cues.en: Then we want to ask a question, what is the capital of France, and we do that with runAsync.
cues.zh: 接著提出「法國首都是哪裡？」這個問題，使用 RunAsync。

cues.en: So that would be method on myAgent.
cues.zh: 這是 MyAgent 上的方法。

cues.en: So I have two versions of each runAsync in here.
cues.zh: 這裡每種 RunAsync 都有兩個版本。

cues.en: I have one with message, and one with list of messages.
cues.zh: 一個接收單一訊息，另一個接收訊息清單。

cues.en: In Agent Framework, they have more.
cues.zh: Agent Framework 提供更多版本，

cues.en: They have one with a list, a single one, myMessage, and various overloads for sessions, and so on.
cues.zh: 包括清單、單一訊息、ChatMessage，以及包含 Session 等各種多載。

cues.en: But for us, the simple thing, we're just keeping it simple, and we're just saying, if we have only one message, we just make it into a list of those messages.
cues.zh: 但這裡保持簡單：如果只有一則訊息，就把它放進訊息清單。

cues.en: And if we look at one of those myMessages here, you can see we have a role.
cues.zh: 看看 MyMessage，可以看到其中有 Role。

cues.en: In Agent Framework, it's an enum, but here we just keep it simple with a string.
cues.zh: Agent Framework 使用列舉，這裡為了簡單，直接用字串。

cues.en: We have some content on what we're sending, and we have some tool calls that I will skip
cues.zh: 另外有要傳送的 Content，以及一些工具呼叫欄位，這部分先，

cues.en: for now, because in the first version here, we don't really use them, but we will get back to them after the fact.
cues.zh: 略過，因為第一個版本還用不到，之後會再回來介紹。

cues.en: But what we get down to is into the runAsync, and what we send in, of course, is our message, which is, what is the capital of France?
cues.zh: 接著進入 RunAsync，傳入的當然是問題訊息，也就是「法國首都是哪裡？」。

cues.en: And the first thing both we do here and Agent Framework do is, it adds one more message, and that is because we have instructions.
cues.zh: 這裡和 Agent Framework 都會先多加入一則訊息，因為我們有設定指示。

cues.en: So my instructions over here was, you are a nice AI, and that need to be sent as a message, and we need to do it every single time.
cues.zh: 這裡的指示是「你是一個友善的 AI」，必須以訊息形式送出，而且每次呼叫都要帶上。

cues.en: So by doing that, we go in and say, get messages to send, we go in and say, make a new list
cues.zh: 因此呼叫 GetMessagesToSend，先建立一份，

cues.en: of messages to send here, and then we go in and say, if the instructions are there, and
cues.zh: 要傳送的訊息清單。接著檢查，如果有指示，而且，

cues.en: the system role is not already there, meaning we haven't put in those instructions yet, we insert it at the top, because we want to have the system message at the top before
cues.zh: 目前沒有 system 角色的訊息，也就是還沒加入這些指示，就插入最前面。因為系統訊息要放在，

cues.en: the user messages.
cues.zh: 使用者訊息之前。

cues.en: That is just fancy words of saying, now we have two messages, one being type system,
cues.zh: 說白一點，現在就有兩則訊息，一則是 system 類型，

cues.en: which is the system prompt, and one being the user message for the user.
cues.zh: 也就是系統提示詞；另一則是使用者提供的 user 訊息。

cues.en: So doing that, we now have the two messages to send.
cues.zh: 如此就準備好兩則要傳送的訊息。

cues.en: And the way we need to send it is with a normal HTTP client, we will see that down here, but we need some JSON to send on that, because it's an HTTP post, just like any other API
cues.zh: 傳送時使用一般 HttpClient，稍後會看到。不過需要先建立 JSON，因為這和其他 API 一樣，都是 HTTP POST，

cues.en: call, but it needs a certain format of that JSON.
cues.zh: 只是 JSON 必須符合特定格式。

cues.en: So down here, I'm using the various JSON arrays, JSON objects in order to build this.
cues.zh: 所以這裡使用 JsonArray、JsonObject 等類別來建立內容。

cues.en: So first off, I need the messages to be in a certain format.
cues.zh: 首先，需要把訊息轉成特定格式。

cues.en: So I go in and put that for each message, I put in the role, and if it has any content, you might say, why wouldn't there not be a content?
cues.zh: 逐一處理每則訊息，放入 role，如果有 content 也一起加入。你可能會問，怎麼會沒有 content？

cues.en: Well, for a user message, there will always be content, but later on, we'll see the tool calls that might not have content.
cues.zh: 使用者訊息當然總會有內容，但稍後會看到，有些工具呼叫訊息可能沒有。

cues.en: So I will explain the case where we don't actually go in here.
cues.zh: 所以之後會解釋，什麼情況不會進入這裡。

cues.en: In our case, of course, we have our normal role of system, and the content, that you
cues.zh: 目前第一則訊息是一般的 system 角色，內容是「你是一個，

cues.en: are nice AI, there are instructions, no tool calls, and no tool call IDs, again, we will go back to those.
cues.zh: 友善的 AI」，也就是指示。沒有工具呼叫，也沒有工具呼叫 ID，稍後會再介紹。

cues.en: And the second message will be our role of user, with our question, what's the capital of France?
cues.zh: 第二則訊息的角色是 user，內容則是「法國首都是哪裡？」。

cues.en: So now we have a list of messages, and we need to put them into an object in JSON called messages.
cues.zh: 現在有了訊息清單，要放進 JSON 物件的 messages 欄位。

cues.en: So right now, our JSON would look something like this.
cues.zh: 因此目前 JSON 會長得像這樣。

cues.en: And if we take this, and see it in a formatter here, it's a very simple set of things that
cues.zh: 放進格式化工具查看，就會看到我們要送出的內容，

cues.en: we need to send.
cues.zh: 其實非常簡單。

cues.en: This is actually the only thing we need to send if we just want to ask this question.
cues.zh: 如果只是提出這個問題，實際上只需要傳送這些。

cues.en: Later on, if we come to structured output, there might be something, but right now, we don't have any structured output, so we'll just skip that, and we'll also just skip all
cues.zh: 之後介紹結構化輸出時，會有其他內容。但現在沒有結構化輸出，所以先略過，也先略過，

cues.en: this tool calling, which we again will go back to.
cues.zh: 這些工具呼叫，稍後再回來介紹。

cues.en: So essentially, what we need to send is this, nothing more.
cues.zh: 因此目前只需要傳送這些，沒有其他內容。

cues.en: We keep that as a JSON object, and we then call the provider.
cues.zh: 以 JsonObject 保留，接著呼叫 Provider。

cues.en: This is Azure OpenAI.
cues.zh: 這裡使用 Azure OpenAI。

cues.en: So what we do is we make an HTTP client, of course, in a real scenario, we'd probably make an HTTP client factory instead of just doing it up here, but I'm keeping it as simple
cues.zh: 先建立 HttpClient。實際系統中，可能會透過 IHttpClientFactory 建立，而不是直接在這裡建立，但這裡要盡可能，

cues.en: as possible here.
cues.zh: 保持簡單。

cues.en: And then we need to send some header data, meaning we send some authorization, and we do that by writing bearer and then the API key.
cues.zh: 接著設定標頭，也就是加入授權資訊，內容是 Bearer 加上 API 金鑰。

cues.en: So now our HTTP client is ready to be called.
cues.zh: 現在 HttpClient 已經準備好送出請求。

cues.en: We need to give it what URL it needs to be called, and the real URL we'll see in one
cues.zh: 還要提供實際呼叫的 URL。稍後會看到真正的 URL，

cues.en: second, but it's definitely not what Azure shows up here.
cues.zh: 但它肯定不是 Azure 在這裡顯示的完整值。

cues.en: Not for Azure OpenAI.
cues.zh: 至少 Azure OpenAI 不是直接使用這個值。

cues.en: For OpenAI, it would be, but for Azure OpenAI, it would not be this.
cues.zh: OpenAI 的做法不同，但 Azure OpenAI 不能直接用這個。

cues.en: And the way I found that out was to use the real one and actually inspect the call to see exactly what the URL was.
cues.zh: 我是透過實際的官方用戶端，再檢查呼叫內容，才知道真正使用的 URL。

cues.en: So I'm just going to remove this part here, we have the URL here, and once I remove it, we have the raw URL.
cues.zh: 因此先移除這裡的一部分，取得基本 URL。

cues.en: And onto that, we need to apply slash OpenAI slash deployments slash model, which is technically
cues.zh: 接著要加上 /openai/deployments/模型名稱。不過嚴格來說，

cues.en: not the model in Azure OpenAI, but deployment name.
cues.zh: 在 Azure OpenAI 裡，這不是模型名稱，而是部署名稱。

cues.en: So up here, if we go to build and go into the deployments, it's the name that is shown
cues.zh: 到上面的 Build，再進入 Deployments，需要提供的是畫面，

cues.en: here that we need to give.
cues.zh: 這裡顯示的名稱。

cues.en: And then we need to say slash chat, because I'm using chat client and not responses API, those responses would have been a little bit different.
cues.zh: 接著加入 /chat，因為使用的是 ChatClient，而不是 Responses API；Responses 的路徑會稍有不同。

cues.en: And special for Azure OpenAI, we need to give an API version as well.
cues.zh: Azure OpenAI 還特別需要指定 API 版本。

cues.en: Again, had we done this against OpenAI, it would have been a slightly different thing.
cues.zh: 同樣地，如果直接呼叫 OpenAI，做法又會稍微不同。

cues.en: And that's where agent framework takes over and do all these things behind the scenes for us, instead of we need to do it.
cues.zh: 這就是 Agent Framework 在背後替我們處理的事情，不必自己實作這些差異。

cues.en: So essentially, we're just calling this URL with our simple format of the two messages, nothing more.
cues.zh: 所以本質上，只是把包含兩則訊息的簡單資料，傳送到這個 URL。

cues.en: And we do a post as JSON, so it knows the right header types and stuff like that.
cues.zh: 使用 PostAsJson，讓它正確設定標頭類型等資訊。

cues.en: And when we do that, we get our response.
cues.zh: 送出後，就會取得回應。

cues.en: So it's a status 200, and we can get our raw data back from the content, which we'll see out here.
cues.zh: 狀態碼是 200，可以從 Content 取得原始資料，稍後會顯示在這裡。

cues.en: So the raw content is this.
cues.zh: 這就是原始內容。

cues.en: So let me take that into this over here.
cues.zh: 先把它移到旁邊查看。

cues.en: So we can see we get back something called choices, which is a lot about the hate speech and sexual and self-harm and all things.
cues.zh: 可以看到回傳了 choices，其中也有仇恨言論、性內容、自傷等各種內容篩選資訊。

cues.en: We're going to get back a finishing reason.
cues.zh: 也會回傳 finish_reason。

cues.en: We're going to get some index and some lock props that we don't really need for anything.
cues.zh: 另外有 index 與 logprobs，這裡暫時用不到。

cues.en: But the real thing is the message down here.
cues.zh: 真正重要的是下面的 message。

cues.en: So inside that, we can see the content is the answer, capital friends, and the role is a system, meaning the AI.
cues.zh: 其中 content 是問題的答案，也就是法國首都；role 則表示這是 AI 助理的訊息。

cues.en: There's, of course, multiple other things here.
cues.zh: 當然還有很多其他欄位。

cues.en: I won't take every single thing of it out in code here.
cues.zh: 這裡不會把每個欄位都映射到程式碼。

cues.en: But I am taking out the ID so we can just see.
cues.zh: 不過會取出 ID，方便觀察。

cues.en: It tells what the real model was and a bit more about the prompt filter, service tier.
cues.zh: 另外也能看到實際模型、提示詞篩選與服務層級等資訊。

cues.en: And I could have also taken out all the user usage data and so on, but I'm not going to do it in this.
cues.zh: 我也可以取得所有用量資訊，但這個範例不會處理。

cues.en: It's just more mapping of JSON onto objects.
cues.zh: 那些只是把更多 JSON 欄位映射到物件。

cues.en: So what we're seeing is that we can actually turn this into an object.
cues.zh: 因此現在要做的，是把這份資料轉成物件。

cues.en: So in my case, I'm just taking out the ID of the object and choices.
cues.zh: 這個例子只取出物件 ID 與 choices。

cues.en: And it's an array, but I've never ever seen it giving back more than one choice.

cues.en: And now we're not stopping, we're not just returning, we're heading down into the finishing region of tool calls, and then we are going to essentially call this again
cues.zh: 現在不會停止，也不會直接回傳，而是進入 finish_reason 為 tool_calls 的分支，之後基本上會再次呼叫，

cues.en: with a slightly modified message to it.

cues.en: So, let's jump into that we need to take the message we want to send, and this message that came back from the system, and react to that tool call.
cues.zh: 接著看看：取得原本要送出的訊息，以及系統回傳的這則訊息，並處理工具呼叫。

cues.en: So, there can technically be multiple tool calls, in reality there aren't normally, they will come one by one, but they are prepared for it in the future.
cues.zh: 技術上可能同時有多個工具呼叫，雖然實際上經常逐一發生，但格式已為多個呼叫預留支援。

cues.en: So, we need to go in and look at the first tool call request, which is just the tool calls of the message. We saw it was a call ID that is randomly generated,
cues.zh: 因此先查看第一個工具呼叫要求，也就是訊息中的 ToolCalls。可以看到有一個隨機產生的呼叫 ID，

cues.en: and it told us about that it's getWeather with some arguments.

cues.en: So, we find that tool, which is just our tool object, but remember it's part it has a delegate on it as well.
cues.zh: 找到工具後，它只是工具物件，但別忘了，其中也包含委派。

cues.en: So, when we go in, we can now see that we can put in that message to the system.
cues.zh: 接著就可以把工具呼叫的訊息加入要傳送的內容。

cues.en: If we are missing a tool or the AI have called it incorrectly with the wrong name, we will just show an exception. In the agent framework we will actually do a retry, resending the previous
cues.zh: 如果找不到工具，或 AI 使用錯誤名稱，就直接拋出例外。Agent Framework 則會嘗試重試，把前面的，

cues.en: But in our case we just throw it directly, and we send a message directly here.
cues.zh: 但這裡只會直接拋出錯誤，並在這裡加入訊息。

cues.en: And now we go in and check if there's any arguments to be sent.
cues.zh: 接著檢查是否有需要傳入的參數。

cues.en: Because if there's arguments to be sent, because we have a tool that needs a parameter, we need to do some more stuff. Had it not been, we would just call our delegate and say dynamically invoke.
cues.zh: 因為這個工具有參數，所以需要額外處理。如果沒有，就直接對委派呼叫 DynamicInvoke。

cues.en: But because we have arguments, we need to turn this into a JSON document or pass it in some way at least.

cues.en: So we need to find the first one is city, that we find in our JSON, which is our argument JSON. Get us

cues.zh: 對應的值，當然就是 Paris。如果型別是 string，就以字串加入呼叫參數。

cues.en: Or else we could put it in as integer. And of course we need to support multiple more here if need be.

cues.en: And those arguments, which is just a single one being Paris right now, we don't need to tell city equals Paris

cues.en: The same way we can do in Agent Framework because we essentially it's a sharp code calling the tool. It's not the LLM.
cues.zh: 和 Agent Framework 一樣，實際呼叫工具的是 C# 程式碼，不是 LLM。

cues.en: It is our code on behalf of the LLM giving the request to us.
cues.zh: 是我們的程式，代表 LLM 依照收到的要求執行。

cues.en: And it put in city equals Paris, which we don't really use here. We just give a stock answer back. But again, it could have gone to a real open weather service and found out the real value.
cues.zh: 這裡傳入 city = Paris，不過模擬工具並沒有真的使用，只回傳固定答案。當然也可以連到真正的天氣服務查詢。

cues.en: In our case, we just give it back and the tool result will come back, which is sunny and 90 degrees. And what we do
cues.zh: 這個例子直接回傳固定結果，工具結果是晴天、90 度。接著，

cues.en: then is we make a new message, which is the tool result message, which is role tool, which if you have studied the messages back from Agent Framework,
cues.zh: 建立新的工具結果訊息，角色是 tool。如果你研究過 Agent Framework 的訊息，

cues.en: it's also the same way. And we add that to the message of the various different calls that have happened so far.
cues.zh: 會發現做法相同。把這則訊息加入目前各次呼叫的訊息紀錄。

cues.en: The first call was the request for the tool and now we give the result of the tool. That is also why in Agent Framework, if you call and one tool happens, you will always get three messages back.
cues.zh: 第一次是工具呼叫要求，現在加入工具結果。因此在 Agent Framework 中，如果發生一次工具呼叫，通常會取得三則回應訊息。

cues.zh: 分別是工具要求、工具結果，以及最後答案。

cues.en: Because when we do this,
cues.zh: 因為當我們這樣處理時，

cues.zh: 原本要傳送的內容只有我們自己的訊息，

cues.en: your nice AI system, the user.

cues.en: But now we are putting in the system tool callback and the result of the tool, which has what the AI needs in order to give the right answer.
cues.zh: 現在則加入模型的工具呼叫要求，以及工具結果，讓 AI 取得正確回答所需的資料。

cues.en: And we are simply calling runAsync again. So before we send it with only one message, put it in the
cues.zh: 接著再次呼叫 RunAsync。原本只傳入一則訊息，再加入，

cues.zh: 指示並取得回應。但現在因為有工具呼叫，所以要再次呼叫 LLM，帶上相同的，

cues.en: message. We have our four messages.
cues.zh: 對話內容。現在一共有四則訊息。

cues.en: It won't change here because we already have the instructions in.
cues.zh: 這裡不會再修改，因為已經有系統指示。

cues.en: We are going to build up the messages.

cues.en: And this time it will go slightly different.

cues.zh: 第一則是系統訊息，和之前完全相同，沒有工具呼叫，也沒有呼叫 ID。

cues.zh: 第二則是使用者訊息。

cues.en: Again, no tool call, no call ID. But now we go in and write the assistance. It doesn't have any content
cues.zh: 同樣沒有工具呼叫或呼叫 ID。接著加入 assistant 訊息，這則沒有 Content，

cues.zh: 所以不加入文字內容。但它有 ToolCalls，因此需要把那個節點序列化，放進 tool_calls。

cues.en: it didn't have a tool ID, the request. It had values about the tool down here.
cues.zh: 工具呼叫要求的訊息本身沒有 ToolCallId，因為相關值在下面的工具呼叫內容裡。

cues.en: But this one we used in ...

cues.en: It has content to the AI but again it's a tool and not the user message. We add that content.
cues.zh: 它有要提供給 AI 的 Content，但角色是 tool，而不是 user。把內容加進來。

cues.en: There's no tool calls in the result of it.
cues.zh: 結果本身沒有 ToolCalls。

cues.en: That was only in the request. But we have our tool call ID meaning we're telling the agent this is the result of the tool call
cues.zh: ToolCalls 只存在要求訊息中。但這裡有 ToolCallId，告訴代理程式：這是某個工具呼叫，

cues.en: ID and we add that message. We end up down in the JSON again. We have our messages done, no structured output.
cues.zh: ID 的結果。加入這則訊息後，再次建立 JSON。訊息已準備完成，沒有結構化輸出。

cues.en: in Paris and Copenhagen for example.
cues.zh: 巴黎與哥本哈根的天氣。

cues.en: And it would need to do one more of these tool calls.

cues.zh: 不過現在的資料已經足夠，所以它有需要的，

cues.zh: JSON。我們來看看，這次基本上會送出四則訊息。

cues.zh: 前兩則原始訊息，再加上工具呼叫要求與工具結果。

cues.zh: 這正是 Agent Framework 在背後執行的流程。

cues.zh: 雖然還有更多錯誤處理與功能，但核心運作就是這樣。接著它會，

cues.zh: 但現在可以看到 finish_reason 是 stop，Content 則是 AI 結合問題、工具呼叫與工具結果後，

cues.zh: 也可以查看訊息，了解它如何先要求工具呼叫、取得工具結果，再，
